title: chelidonium majus var. fumariifolium
intro: Chelidonium majus var. fumariifolium, commonly known as Celandine, is a variety of the Greater Celandine plant, which is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Celandine include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating a range of conditions, including skin issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of Celandine include its ability to stimulate the liver and kidneys, as well as its anti-cancer properties, which have been demonstrated in various studies. The bioactive constituents of Celandine include alkaloids such as chelidonine and chelerythrine, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
